# IThrottleTracker

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Resilience.IThrottleTracker`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Tracks throttle state across connections. Used by the connection pool to route requests away from throttled connections.
